title: generate_summary: request a natural-language explanation of the result
description: Request the result explainer to produce a natural-language summary of the final workflow output. Does not modify the data. Should always be the last step in a workflow. Use this when the user asks for an explanation, insight, or conclusion about the data.
rag_note: Takes no parameters. Must be the last step in a workflow. The explainer runs after execution and generates a grounded explanation based on the actual execution result, not LLM guessing. Do not place this step before data transformation steps.
